title: DRAFT — AutoHost task manifest `agent` block (Stage B, not wired in)
description: DRAFT, derived only from docs/AGENT_RUNTIME.md section 4.2 (config.agent) and section 15 (Stage B sketch). Not referenced by schemas/task.schema.json, ManifestValidator or any generator; promoted in P13-18 after the Stage-A gates pass on a real device. All numbers are placeholders. Semantics the draft cannot express (tools must be a subset of the generated catalog; budgets may only tighten host ceilings; unattended runs need verify, declared budgets and a visible Stop notification) are enforced by the future validator and preflight, not by this file.

goal.description: The task the model is asked to do; may be templated from the task's config (templating syntax UNDECIDED, P13-18).

supervised.description: true = a human confirms completion (ui.prompt.ask confirm). false = unattended: requires budgets and verify.

tools.description: Names from the generated tool catalog (AGENT_RUNTIME section 6); may only narrow the default set. Uniqueness and catalog membership are checked by the validator.

packages.description: Android package names that scope the package-scoped grants. Whether a task declares them here or through the existing manifest grant mechanism is UNDECIDED (P13-18, X-15).

budgets.description: May only tighten the host ceilings (AGENT_RUNTIME section 7). Placeholder defaults live in the host, not here.

screenshots.description: Default false; a screenshot leaves the device only if the user enabled it for the provider (plan 14.7).

verify.description: Host-evaluated completion checks (selector/state checks through broker reads after finish). Structure UNDECIDED — to be fixed in P13-18; required when supervised is false.
